description:
Do one task inside your own conversation and keep only its summary. Call {"op": "start", "task": "Find where the config is read"} first: that call is the mark. Work as usual (call tools, think). When done call {"op": "end", "summary": "The config is read in cfg/load.py; it needs AOS_HOME."}: every message of yours after the mark, up to this call, is replaced by one message "[aos] summary: lines A-B, N messages. Task \"...\" ended: SUMMARY". The summary is required. Messages from others that came in during the task (letters, goal reminders) are not folded; they stay, after the summary. Tasks may nest (at most 5 deep); end closes the innermost. {"op": "status"} lists the open tasks (they survive a restart). The removed messages are kept in a file next to your history. Only for an agent-fsm body: elsewhere BodyUnsupported. Errors: ArgumentsBad, OpUnknown, TaskMissing, MarkerMissing, DepthExceeded, BodyUnsupported, StateBad, WriteFailed, DaemonMissing, DaemonFailed, InstanceMissing.
Details: knowledge_read aos/me.json#/do_task.

op.description: start = mark here and begin a task, end = fold the task into your summary, status = list the open tasks

task.description: start: one sentence, what this task is for (optional; it goes into the summary line)

summary.description: end (required): what the task found or did, the facts you still need later; it replaces the task's messages
